query:
SELECT c.id AS "company_id!",
                  (SELECT ws.timezone FROM company_work_schedules ws
                   WHERE ws.company_id = c.id AND ws.is_default = TRUE)
                      AS "timezone?",
                  c.auto_absent_last_run_date AS "last_run_date?"
           FROM companies c
           WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
           ORDER BY c.id
